content_status.title: Change content status
content_status.auto_hint: Follow the article and publication records
content_status.draft_hint: Mark as a draft to keep working on it
content_status.published_hint: Mark as published, including on other channels

facebook_comments.title: Facebook comments
facebook_comments.empty: Facebook has not returned any viewable comments.
facebook_comments.no_text: This comment has no text. View it on Facebook.
facebook_comments.hint: Comments and replies appear newest first. Visibility restrictions may make the available comments fewer than the total count.

facebook_retry.hint: The post may already be live. Check the result again or open the Facebook Page. Retry only after confirming it was not published.
facebook_retry.confirm_title: Confirm the post was not published
facebook_retry.confirm_hint: Check the previous content below on the "{name}" Page first. After confirming it was not published, retry with the currently saved caption and images. If the original post exists, cancel and check the result again.
facebook_retry.checked: I checked the Page and confirmed this previous post was not published.

facebook_connect.browser_desc: Log in to Facebook to use a personal profile or Page. This method also supports images and videos.
facebook_connect.api_desc: Authorize Facebook and choose the Pages you manage. The official channel supports text, single-image and multi-image posts; use the browser for videos.
facebook_connect.local_only: Connect Facebook and choose Pages in Annulo on your computer.
facebook_connect.unavailable: Facebook authorization is not enabled in this Annulo build. Use a test build that supports it.
facebook_connect.missing: Page permissions are missing. Reauthorize Facebook and allow access to the required Pages.
facebook_connect.pending: Complete authorization on the Facebook page. This dialog will update automatically.
facebook_connect.authorize_hint: After authorization, choose the Pages to use in this project.
facebook_connect.title: Facebook connection method
facebook_connect.metrics_limited: Collection is limited for: {metrics}. Available data has been synced; previous values are preserved for other metrics. Check Page authorization and app permissions.
facebook_connect.metrics_available: Follower, like, comment and share counts are accessible.
facebook_connect.metrics_unsupported: This API channel does not provide view or save counts. Unavailable metrics are not shown as zero.
facebook_connect.probe_limited: Publishing authorization is available; some data is unavailable
facebook_connect.probe_ok: Publishing authorization and data access checks passed

article.type_hint: Each type has its own fields and goes to different platforms; you can "Rewrite" it into another type later.
article.t_post_desc: Title + plain text + a set of images; the first is the cover.
article.desc_ph: What the video is about and who it's for
article.post_ph: Text: short paragraphs; emoji are fine
article.limit_images: Max images: {list}; the first is the cover, drag to reorder
article.category_hint: Bilibili needs a category; enter its name
article.no_video: No video yet: click "Edit" to pick or upload one
article.no_images: No images: a text cover is made from the cover text
article.pub_unsupported: This platform doesn't take this type ({type})
article.pub_expired: Login expired: log in again under Accounts
article.pub_too_long: Text is {n} long, over this platform's limit of {max}: it may not post; shorten or rewrite it first
article.pub_sent_before: Posted {when}: publishing again posts it a second time
article.legacy_version: An older media version (may differ from the article): delete it to post the article instead
article.delete_published: This article has been posted or scheduled, so it can't be deleted: handle it under Publishing first.
article.rewrite_title: Hand it to AI as a new piece
article.rewrite_hint: Rewrites "{title}" into a new article your way; the original stays as it is and the new one appears in the list.
article.convert_hint: No AI: keeps the content as is and only changes the format for the type (long-form headings and paragraphs become plain lines and its images become the post images; the other way, each line becomes a paragraph), saved as a new article
article.rewrite_note_hint: Leave empty to rewrite in the usual style for this type, or tweak a preset or write your own.
article.rewrite_ph_article: e.g. Expand into a ~1500-word article with headings
article.rewrite_ph_post: e.g. Short, under 200 words, open with a hook
article.rewrite_ph_video: e.g. Title and description for a 1-minute talking-head video
article.presets_empty: No presets yet: pick a type, write the instructions and click "Save as preset", or add one under "Manage presets".
article.rewriting_desc: The result is saved as a new article under "Rewritten articles" below and in the list; click "View" to follow along.
article.pub_site_setup: This website's article publishing isn't set up yet
article.pub_site_update: Published: publishing again updates it on the site
article.pub_started_toast: Publishing to {n} accounts; follow progress at the bottom right and in the article's publishing record
article.pub_show_wait: The browser isn't open at this step yet; try again in a moment
article.pub_show_old: This Annulo can't show the publishing window yet: update Annulo first
article.open_account_data: Open this account in Performance: open its profile, collect again
article.pub_target_account: Target account: {name}. Verify the content, assets and selected account before publishing.
article.pub_target_missing: The account changed; verify it again
article.make_video_hint: Make a video from "{title}": AI produces it on this computer and saves it as a new video article, with a version for every change. The original stays as is.
article.make_video_note_hint: Describe the video you want: length, landscape or portrait, style, pace, captions, which tool to use… Leave it empty to follow the norms of the platforms you post to.
article.make_video_ph: e.g. 60 seconds, portrait, state the takeaway in the first 3 seconds, big captions, fast pace, made with Remotion

choose_accounts.empty: No Pages are available. Allow access to the required Pages during authorization and check that this account can publish to them.
choose_accounts.desc: This Facebook account manages the Pages below. Pick the ones to run in this project (you can pick just one Page and pick others when you sign in from another project).

inspiration.title: Inspiration library
inspiration.empty_sources: Save a link or source text, then turn it into your own topic.
inspiration.empty_creators: Add a creator or brand account and link their content.
inspiration.person_hint: Group only confirmed accounts of one person or brand.
inspiration.creator: Reference creator
inspiration.unknown_metrics: Leave unknown metrics blank; recorded metrics need a date.
inspiration.media_hint: Use source media as reference. Choose production assets from the asset library.
inspiration.review_desc: The assistant reviews this source and product facts, then saves observations and original angles.
inspiration.generate_desc: Generate topics from this source, product facts and user scenarios, preserving references.
inspiration.no_references: No references yet. Select one from the library.
inspiration.snapshot_hint: Reference records preserve the source at selection or writing time.
inspiration.no_creator_sources: Select this account when saving a source to link inspirations.
inspiration.import_hint: The file contains origin, creators and inspirations arrays. Validate first; existing records are skipped.
inspiration.import_done: Imported {creators} accounts and {sources} inspirations; skipped {skipped} existing records.
inspiration.import_too_large: JSON files must be smaller than 20 MB

presets.name: Name
presets.name_hint: Shown on the button; leave empty to show the start of the instructions
presets.revise_ph: e.g. Faster pace, cut the repeated shots

make_video.name: Make a video
make_video.prompt: Make a video for the platforms it will go to: 9:16 portrait for Douyin and Xiaohongshu, 16:9 landscape for YouTube and Bilibili; about 60 seconds. Say what the video is about in the first 3 seconds, follow the structure of the document, get the key points across in voice-over or captions, and end with a line inviting people to follow.

video_tighter.name: Faster pace
video_tighter.prompt: Make the pace faster: cut repeated or slow shots and pauses, one point per shot, about a third shorter overall. Leave everything else as is.

video_captions.name: Bigger captions
video_captions.prompt: Make the captions bigger and bold, inside the safe area at the bottom, with key words highlighted in the primary color, readable on a phone without zooming. Leave everything else as is.
